title: Four Held for Kidnapping Odisha Businessman, Including Police Officer and Journalist
summary: Police have arrested four individuals, including a police officer and a journalist, in connection with the kidnapping of a businessman from Odisha. Authorities stated that the kidnapping was orchestrated with the intent to extort ₹50 lakh from the victim. The arrests were made following the planning of the crime.
summary_points: Four people were arrested for kidnapping an Odisha businessman.
Among the arrested are a police officer and a journalist.
The motive for the kidnapping was to extort ₹50 lakh.
Police confirmed the kidnapping was a planned operation.

summary_points_hi: ओडिशा के एक व्यवसायी के अपहरण के आरोप में चार लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया गया है।
